summary_en: HHH1 LLC will launch a tender offer for all ordinary shares and warrant securities of circlace Inc. at 2,020 yen per share, with a minimum tender threshold of 2,970,800 shares. The offer period runs from October 23 to December 7, 2026 (30 business days), with the goal of taking the company private and delisting it from the TSE Growth Market.
title_en: Notice of Opinion in Support and Recommendation for Tender Offer for Our Shares and Warrant Securities by HHH1 LLC
translation_en_brief: On October 22, 2026, circlace Inc. announced that its board of directors has expressed support for and recommends that shareholders participate in a tender offer launched by HHH1 LLC, a limited liability company. The offer price is set at 2,020 yen per ordinary share. The tender offer will run for 30 business days from October 23 to December 7, 2026, with a minimum tender threshold of 2,970,800 shares. The offer also covers warrant securities (1st, 3rd, 4th, and 6th series), each priced at 1 yen per warrant. HHH1 LLC is an investment vehicle established on April 10, 2025, with Inspire APAC Holdings Pte. Ltd. as its sole member. The bidder has no prior capital, personnel, or business relationships with circlace. The board's recommendation is conditional on the bidder's intention to acquire all shares and take the company completely private, resulting in the delisting of circlace shares from the Tokyo Stock Exchange Growth Market. The company's board recommended that shareholders participate in the offer, while warrant holders are left to decide whether to tender their securities at their own discretion.
